## Frozen Authority

This owner statement promotes the verified candidate at commit
`bd010e20eb8a7901aa677810aa7a5c982a436e07` without scientific change. It
freezes SCI-MAP v0.1/r0.7.1 as the active scientific authority for:

- the standalone science-team rationale, complete formal contract, and
  engineering conformance view;
- the r0.7.1 shared wrapper and six canonical common modules;
- all 52 stable requirements and 25 stable predictions;
- the exact `SCI-PTC_TO_SCI-MAP v0.1/r0.1` and
  `SCI-AST_TO_SCI-MAP_ORIGINAL_FOOTPRINT_COORDINATE v0.1/r0.1` boundaries;
- the exact MAP-owned upstream-admission, one-hot projection, uniform coadd
  coefficient, and observation-coadd admission profiles;
- the nine-entry owner-decision ledger, retaining eight `OPEN` decisions and
  resolved `SCI-MAP-OD-008`;
- the exact SCI-VAL Registry and source-binding revisions and byte ranges
  bound by `SCI-MAP_SOURCE_MANIFEST v0.1/r0.7.1`; and
- the three canonical PDFs and their byte-identical r0.7.1 aliases.

The frozen source manifest is `SOURCE_MANIFEST_R0.7.md`, SHA-256
`bd3f172f8bb1e17bf95fde034ad76632439c766ef89b0a992361b9e6d79ada0a`.
Its external companion is `SOURCE_MANIFEST_R0.7.sha256`, SHA-256

## Preserved Open States And Claim Boundary

Freeze does not resolve the eight open MAP owner decisions. It does not select
the missing exact PTC MAP-facing coefficient family or admit a numerical
`coverage_cut` state/value. Consequently the ordinary source-closed numerical
MAP route remains unavailable under the exact frozen contract.

This freeze establishes document identity and scientific authority only. It
does not establish implementation conformity, representation fidelity,
numerical or observational validation, achieved response fidelity,
observational performance, science qualification, default activation,
production readiness, or production authorization.

## Change Control

The freeze promotion is status-only. It changes no definition, equation,
assumption, requirement, prediction, estimator, response, exposure, support,
covariance, coadd, lifecycle, source binding, owner decision, or
unavailable-state consequence. Any future substantive correction, resolved
open choice, or changed scientific boundary requires explicit owner authority
and a versioned successor or formally reopened revision. Frozen r0.7.1
authority must not be silently edited.
